### Free-text responses

```{r}
#| echo: false
source(file.path(book_root, "R/recodes/train5_recode.R"))

cleaned_data <- process_text_codes_with_allocation(
  filter = FILTER,
  question_code = "train5",
  recode_map = train5_recode_map, 
  header = "Training Capacity",
  other = TRUE,
  cache_id = "train5"
)

cleaned_data$summary_table
```

The raw-to-category allocation table for this question is in @sec-appendix-recoding.
